sqf: private _loc = (nearestLocations [[worldSize/2, worldSize/2, 0], ['NameCity','NameCityCapital','NameVillage'], 50000]) select {(toLower (text _x)) find 'mazem' >= 0}; if (count _loc == 0) exitWith {}; private _cityPos = position (_loc select 0); systemChat '[OPFOR Command] Infantry squads deploying to defensive positions!'; for '_i' from 1 to 4 do { private _spawnPos = [(_cityPos select 0) + (random 300) - 150, (_cityPos select 1) + (random 300) - 150, 0]; private _grp = createGroup EAST; private _units = ['CUP_O_RU_Soldier_SL_M_EMR','CUP_O_RU_Soldier_TL_M_EMR','CUP_O_RU_Soldier_AR_M_EMR','CUP_O_RU_Soldier_AR_M_EMR','CUP_O_RU_Soldier_LAT_M_EMR','CUP_O_RU_Soldier_AT_M_EMR','CUP_O_RU_Soldier_Marksman_M_EMR','CUP_O_RU_Soldier_M_EMR']; { _grp createUnit [_x, _spawnPos, [], 5, 'FORM']; } forEach _units; _grp setBehaviour 'AWARE'; _grp setCombatMode 'RED'; [_grp, _cityPos, 100] call BIS_fnc_taskDefend; }; systemChat '[OPFOR] 4 infantry squads in defensive positions!';
